title: AGCP Message Envelope
description: Draft envelope for the Agentic Grid Communication Protocol. Derived from the prose schema in Architecture/Extensive/AGCP_PROTOCOL_SCHEMAS.md with the deltas recorded in Architecture/Schemas/README.md. Non-normative until frozen.

id.description: Version-4 UUID, unique per logical message and stable across retries (CON-CORE-002).

version.description: Semantic version of the AGCP revision the sender implements (CON-CORE-003). Do not use a literal.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds at which the message was created.

from.description: Identifier of the source node. Must not be a personal identifier.

type.description: Message kind. 'error' is added relative to the prose schema so that CON-CORE-012 has a typed carrier.

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier preserved across every bridge translation (CON-CORE-005).

signature.description: Message-level signature over the canonical serialisation. Authentication itself belongs to the transport (CON-CORE-009); credentials must not appear here (CON-CORE-011).

encoding.description: Serialisation of the data field. 'binary' is intentionally not permitted; see README alignment delta 2.

maxPayloadBytes.description: Declared maximum payload size for this message class, enforced at the receiver (CON-CORE-013).

ttlSeconds.description: Optional lifetime after which the message must be discarded rather than delivered.

context.description: Optional non-identifying metadata such as tenant, region, or protocol revision of the originating bridge.

data.description: Message payload. Shape is determined by the type field and the bridge that produced it.
